{"hypotheses": 
  [
    {"name": "H1",
     "mechanism": "Firms with high patent activity and R&D spending, but low recent performance may be undervalued. Investors fail to fully price in the future earnings potential of these firms' innovative activities.",
     "expression": {
      "terms": [
        {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "PatentsRD"}, 
        {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "RD"}, 
        {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "Mom12m"}],
      "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN",
      "vol_target": true},
     "auxiliary_predictions": [
        {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"},
        {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "weaker"},
        {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Beta", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}],
     "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.75,
     "expected_decay_half_life_months": 36},
     
    {"name": "H2",
     "mechanism": "Firms with high advertising expense but low recent performance may be preparing for a product launch or a market expansion, which may drive future earnings.",
     "expression": {
      "terms": [
        {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "AdExp"},
        {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "Mom6m"}],
      "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE",
      "vol_target": true},
     "auxiliary_predictions": [
        {"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "higher"},
        {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"},
        {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "same_sign"}],
     "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7,
     "expected_decay_half_life_months": 24},
     
    {"name": "H3",
     "mechanism": "Firms with high asset growth but low profitability are often undervalued. These firms might be investing in future growth which is not yet reflected in their earnings.",
     "expression": {
      "terms": [
        {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "AssetGrowth"},
        {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "RoE"}],
      "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN",
      "vol_target": true},
     "auxiliary_predictions": [
        {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "stronger"},
        {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Size", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3},
        {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "same_sign"}],
     "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.85,
     "expected_decay_half_life_months": 18},

    {"name": "H4",
     "mechanism": "Firms with high book leverage and low market leverage may be financially sturdy, especially during a market downturn.",
     "expression": {
      "terms": [
        {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "BookLeverage"},
        {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "Leverage"}],
      "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN",
      "vol_target": false},
     "auxiliary_predictions": [
        {"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "higher"},
        {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "stronger"},
        {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}],
     "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.9,
     "expected_decay_half_life_months": null},

    {"name": "H5",
     "mechanism": "Firms with high cash holdings and high share repurchases are financially healthy and may be undervalued due to a conservative financial strategy.",
     "expression": {
      "terms": [
        {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Cash"},
        {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "ShareRepurchase"}],
      "regime": null,
      "vol_target": true},
     "auxiliary_predictions": [
        {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "stronger"},
        {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Beta", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3},
        {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}],
     "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8,
     "expected_decay_half_life_months": 30},

    {"name": "H6",
     "mechanism": "Firms with high gross profits and low market leverage are operationally efficient and less susceptible to market volatility.",
     "expression": {
      "terms": [
        {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "GP"},
        {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "Leverage"}],
      "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE",
      "vol_target": false},
     "auxiliary_predictions": [
        {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "stronger"},
        {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"},
        {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Beta", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}],
     "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7,
     "expected_decay_half_life_months": 24},

    {"name": "H7",
     "mechanism": "Firms with active shareholders and high governance index may be more likely to adopt value-creating policies, improving their future performance.",
     "expression": {
      "terms": [
        {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Activism2"},
        {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "Governance"}],
      "regime": null,
      "vol_target": false},
     "auxiliary_predictions": [
        {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "stronger"},
        {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"},
        {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Beta", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}],
     "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.65,
     "expected_decay_half_life_months": 48},

    {"name": "H8",
     "mechanism": "Firms with high abnormal accruals but low short interest may be efficiently managed but overlooked by the market, leading to potential undervaluation.",
     "expression": {
      "terms": [
        {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "AbnormalAccruals"},
        {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "ShortInterest"}],
      "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP",
      "vol_target": true},
     "auxiliary_predictions": [
        {"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "higher"},
        {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "stronger"},
        {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "same_sign"}],
     "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.6,
     "expected_decay_half_life_months": 24}
  ]
}
